title: Needle
tagline: A decentralized Twitter-like social app network on Arweave
description:
This app runs on AO and has the following main features:
1. Create and view posts of anyone registered on the platform
2. Comment on others' posts to share your opinion
3. Follow other people on the platform
how_its_made: This app runs on AO which means that the entire backend is on Arweave which runs through processes. The frontend is made with React.js + Vite, JavaScript and Tailwind CSS.
